app.name: FITD Wii Teste 07.1
app.short_description: Body variants, 5-second gallery pages, real motion offsets
app.long_description: Integrated original AITD1 asset testing with paged animation previews at a slower rate, safe switching of skeleton-compatible BODY models, explicit 287/288 checks on 18-group skeletons, and original animation root-motion diagnostics. Stable camera masks and articulated rest preserved. Not a fully playable game. Original game PAK files required and never bundled.
